feed.title: antxiko — commented disassemblies of 8-bit games
feed.subtitle: Old 8-bit binaries taken apart byte by byte and commented, with the tools to rebuild them: nothing gets claimed that the binary does not show, and the source has to give the original back, byte for byte. Right now that means 48 MSX games.

entry.title: War in Middle Earth: the tape, now a cartridge
entry.summary: The game is untouched: a 64 KB ASCII16 cartridge whose loader leaves RAM exactly as the tape loader leaves it and jumps to the same place. Checked byte for byte against the tape, RAM, VRAM, VDP and PSG, on four machines. Nine seconds instead of six and a half minutes.
